candidates.hook: Towering flames consume the cottage as a soot-covered Juliana weeps, 'Our home... Everything we had is gone.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana asks in apprehension, 'What are you going to do?' as Alexander stares into the fire with cold, lethal fury.
candidates.why: It delivers high emotional devastation followed by the irresistible promise of dark, protective vengeance from an elite soldier.

candidates.hook: The bedroom door crashes open violently and Alexander bursts through the roaring blaze yelling, 'Juliana! Get up!'
candidates.cliffhanger: A massive burning crossbeam collapses in a fiery explosion, cutting right as Alexander roars in terror: 'Juliana!'
candidates.why: Non-stop physical peril that immediately grips the audience and cuts at the exact split second Juliana is about to be crushed by falling fire.

candidates.hook: Juliana spots her keepsake in the inferno and screams 'The ledger!', fighting Alexander as he orders 'Leave it!'
candidates.cliffhanger: A burning rafter violently splits overhead and Juliana lets out a blood-curdling scream of 'Alexander!' as danger falls.
candidates.why: A rapid 30-second burst of adrenaline highlighting her emotional attachment to her mother's ledger and an immediate life-or-death crisis.

moments.desc: Alexander kicks the burning bedroom door down and rushes through smoke to hoist Juliana out of bed.
A flaming rafter splits above Juliana and Alexander dives across the room to tackle her before it crushes her.
Alexander coldly vows vengeance against those who burned their home, leaving Juliana to ask what he plans to do.
